# Unique page titles
## Problem
Search results show the same title for every page. Addresses SE1.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1 Each indexable route has its own title that names the page
- [ ] AC2 Each indexable route has its own description
## Out of scope
Sitemap (goal 2).
## Security and privacy
Not applicable: public marketing content only.
## Risk coverage
| Correction | Scope | Criteria / reason and destination |
|---|---|---|
| SE1.a — unique title | in | AC1 |
| SE1.b — unique description | in | AC2 |
